# bgcut

bgcut is a free background remover that runs locally in the browser, from the command line, or through a Node.js API. The hosted browser app keeps source images on the user's device and uses WebGPU when available.

- [Background remover](https://bgcut.dev/)
- [Documentation](https://bgcut.dev/docs)
- [Changelog](https://bgcut.dev/changelog)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jhomra21/bgcut)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bgcut)
